address_book.delete_confirm_body: Susa leli kheli ebhukwini lakho lamakheli?
address_book.saved_unverified_body: Ikheli ligciniwe. I-EasyPost ayikwazanga ukuliqinisekisa, ngakho-ke qinisekisa imininingwane ngaphambi kokuthumela.
address_book.title: Ibhuku lamakheli
android_app.checksum_note: Qhathanisa ifayela olilandile ne-checksum ye-SHA-256 ngaphambi kokufaka.
android_app.intro: Landa i-Easy-Post Mobile Companion ye-Android ngokuqondile, bese uyibhangqa nale khompyutha ukuze ulandelele futhi uphathe izithuthwa usebenzisa ifoni.
android_app.needs_production: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android lubhangqa nenguqulo yokusebenza ngempela. Yenza ilayisensi yokukhiqiza isebenze ukuze uyilande futhi uyibhangqe.
android_app.play_soon: Izofika maduze ku-Google Play. Lokhu kulanda okuqondile kuyinguqulo yokufinyelela kwakuqala kwabaphethe ilayisensi yokukhiqiza ngesikhathi uhlu lwe-Play Store lusaqedelwa.
android_app.reinstall_note: Le nguqulo yokufinyelela kwakuqala isayinwe ngokuzimela kokukhishwa kwe-Google Play. Kungadingeka ukufaka kabusha kusuka ku-Google Play uma uhlu selusebenza; ukubhangqa kuyaqhubeka, ngakho akukho lutho olulahlekayo.
android_app.steps:
1. Landa i-APK efonini ye-Android, noma uyidlulisele kuyo.
2. Vula ifayela, bese uvumela ukufakwa kusuka kulo mthombo uma ucelwa.
3. Vula i-Easy-Post Mobile Companion bese ukhetha Bhangqa.
4. Khiqiza ikhodi yokubhangqa ngaphansi kwe-Amathuluzi bese uthi Bhangqa uhlelo lokusebenza lweselula, bese uyiskena.
android_app.title: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Android
batch_shipments.catalogue_empty: Azikho izevisi ezitholakalayo. Xhuma kanye ukuze ulande ikhathalogu yezinkampani ezithuthayo.
batch_shipments.confirm_buy_body: Thenga amalebula okuthumela kuwo wonke amaphakethe avumelekile kule batch.
batch_shipments.export_no_labels: Qala uthenge iqoqo bese wenza amalebula, bese ukhiphela ishidi ngaphandle.
batch_shipments.missing_service_body: Khetha inkampani ethuthayo nesevisi. I-batch ayinawo amanani ongawakhetha kamuva, ngakho isevisi kumele isethwe ngaphambi kokuba i-batch idalwe.
batch_shipments.quoted_only_note: Kubonisa kuphela izinsizakalo ezinikezwe intengo kumugqa {line}. Maka u-“Bonisa zonke izinkampani ezithuthayo” ukubona zonke.
batch_shipments.show_all_carriers_tip: Ngokuzenzakalelayo kubalwa kuphela izinkampani ezithuthayo ezivuliwe kule akhawunti ye-EasyPost.
batch_shipments.show_all_forced_tip: Izinkampani ezithuthayo ezivuliwe azikwazi ukutholakala kumodi yokuhlola, ngakho zonke izinkampani ziyabalwa.
batch_shipments.signature_required_note: I-{service} ithengiswa kuphela nesignesha, ngakho lelo khetho lihlala livuliwe. Ngaphandle kwalo i-batch iyadalwa kodwa ayikwazi ukuthengwa.
batch_shipments.title: Izimpahla ze-batch
batch_shipments.track_label: Faka lezi zimpahla Ekulandeleleni uma sezithengiwe
batch_shipments.track_tip: Ukulandelela kwenkampani ethuthayo kuhlala kusebenza kwilebula ethengiwe. Lokhu kukopisha nganye nasekhasini Lokulandelela.
claims.attachment_required_note: Izicelo zomonakalo nokwebiwa ziyenqatshwa uma kungekho okungenani idokhumenti eyodwa esekelayo, njengesithombe somonakalo noma i-invoyisi.
claims.description: Faka isicelo ngokumelene nokumbozwa komshwalense wempahla ethunyelwe elahlekile, elimele, noma ebiwe.
claims.filing_window_note: Isicelo singafakwa phakathi kwezinsuku ezingu-15 nezingu-60 ngemva kokuthengwa komshwalense.
claims.title: Izicelo
connect_agents.allow_spending_label: Vumela abameli bacele ukuthenga (imvume yakho isadingeka)
connect_agents.approvals_intro: Ukuthenga okuceliwe umeli. Akukho okuthengiwe okwamanje. Imininingwane ivela ku-EasyPost, hhayi kumeli.
connect_agents.clients_intro: Lawa maklayenti e-MCP atholakele kule khompyutha. Ukuxhuma kwengeza okufakiwe kufayela lawo lokucushwa; ifayela elikhona liyagcinwa kuqala futhi akukho okunye okushintshayo.
connect_agents.confirm_spend_body:
Thenga i-{carrier} ngo-{amount} {currency} kumodi ye-{mode}?

Lokhu kuchitha imali yangempela uma imodi yokukhiqiza isebenza.
connect_agents.manual_intro: Kunoma yiliphi iklayenti elingabhalwanga ngenhla, engeza lokhu ekucushweni kwalo kwe-MCP. Amaningi asebenzisa u-“mcpServers”; i-VS Code isebenzisa u-“servers”.
connect_agents.no_clients: Awekho amaklayenti e-MCP atholakele. Sebenzisa ukusetha ngesandla okungezansi.
connect_agents.relay_config_label: Namathisela lokhu ku-configuration ye-MCP yeklayenti lakho le-AI. Amaningi amaklayenti afaka amaseva ngaphansi kuka-"mcpServers"; i-VS Code isebenzisa u-"servers".
connect_agents.relay_intro: Le app ifinyelela emakhasini eAI ngokusebenzisa i-relay ephephile: yenza kuphela uxhumo oluphumayo — akukho okulalele uxhumo olungenayo ku-Mac yakho. I-relay ayikaze ibone ikhiye lakho le-EasyPost futhi ayikaze isebenzise ithuluzi; ithuluzi ngalinye lisebenza lapha, futhi ukuthenga kusadinga ukugunyazwa kwakho ngezansi.
connect_agents.relay_optin_intro: Ngokuzikhethela, finyelela kule app usuka kwelinye ikhompyutha, noma kusuka kumakhasimende amukela kuphela i-URL, ngokusebenzisa i-relay evikelekile. Inketho yasendaweni engenhla iyinketho ezenzakalelayo futhi ayidingi inethiwekhi. I-relay yenza kuphela uxhumano oluphumayo, ayikaze ibone ukhiye wakho we-EasyPost futhi ayikaze isebenzise ithuluzi; ukuthenga kusadinga imvume yakho engezansi.
connect_agents.relay_regenerate_confirm_: Lokhu kuzokunqamula ngokushesha noma yiliphi iklayenti le-AI elisebenzisa itokheni lamanje. Kuzodingeka unamathisele i-configuration entsha kwiklayenti ngalinye. Qhubeka?
connect_agents.relay_status_running: Ixhunyiwe — amaklayenti e-AI angafinyelela kule app ngesikhathi ivuliwe.
connect_agents.relay_status_stopped: Ayixhunyiwe. Vula "Nika ithuba lokufinyelela kwe-ejenti ye-AI" ngenhla ukuze uqale.
connect_agents.relay_token_warning: Phatha le configuration njengephasiwedi: itokheni livumela iklayenti le-AI ukuthi lifunde idatha yakho yokuthumela nezinani zesitolo (alikaze lisebenzise imali) ngesikhathi le app ivuliwe. Yenza kabusha uma likhe lavezwa.
connect_agents.relay_url_form_label: Noma, kwiklayenti elemukela kuphela i-URL (ngaphandle kwamaheda):
connect_agents.safety_explainer: Abameli bangafunda idatha yakho, baqinisekise amakheli futhi baqhathanise amanani ngaphandle kokubuza. Abasoze bakwazi ukuthenga ngqo: ukuthenga kuba yisicelo osivumela lapha, futhi imininingwane ithathwa ku-EasyPost, hhayi kulokho okushiwo umeli. Noma yini engaphezu kwale mikhawulo iyenqatshwa esikhundleni sokulethwa ukuze igunyazwe. Faka u-0 ukususa umkhawulo.
connect_agents.title: Xhuma abameli be-AI
connect_agents.unsupported_body: Ukuxhuma abameli be-AI nge-MCP okwamanje kusekelwa kuphela kunguqulo elandwa ngqo ye-Easy-Post Desktop. Kudinga ukuthi olunye uhlelo lokusebenza luqale inqubo yosizo kulokhu kufakwa futhi lubhale kumafayela okucushwa awamanye amahlelo, futhi iphakethe le-Microsoft Store ayikwazi ukwenza kokubili ngokwethembekile.
connect_agents.unsupported_link: Inguqulo elandwa ngqo iyatholakala ku-easy-post.spencerfields.com. Konke okunye kusebenza ngendlela efanayo kuzo zombili izinguqulo.
connect_agents.verified_note: Le mininingwane ilandwe kabusha ku-EasyPost kusetshenziswa kuphela izinkomba ezinikezwe umeli. Uma lokhu kungeyona obukulindele, yenqaba.
create_shipment.buy_needs_full_address: Shintshela ku-“Amakheli aphelele” ukuze uthenge le ntengo.
create_shipment.customs_hts_hint: Udinga ikhodi yentela? Sebenzisa ikhasi lokubheka Ikhodi ye-HTS.
create_shipment.customs_intro: Izinkampani ezithuthayo ziyayenqaba ukuthengwa kwelebula uma kungekho imininingwane ephelele ye-Customs kunoma yimuphi umthwalo odlula umngcele wamazwe ngamazwe.
create_shipment.customs_validation_body: Le mpahla ethunyelwe idlula umngcele wamazwe ngamazwe. Qedela ingxenye ye-Customs kuqala: uhlobo lwesiqukathi, igama losayina, isiqinisekiso, kanye nento eyodwa ye-Customs okungenani enencazelo, inani, inani lemali, isisindo, nezwe lomsuka.
create_shipment.delete_package_confirm_b: Susa iphakethe elilondoloziwe '{name}'? Lokhu ngeke kubuyiselwe.
create_shipment.insurance_tooltip: Okukhethwayo. Bika inani lokushwalensa iphasela; imali yokumboza ikhokhwa lapho uthenga ilebula.
create_shipment.missing_addresses_body: Qinisekisa okungenani amakheli amabili ebhukwini lamakheli kuqala.
create_shipment.missing_name_body: Le mpahla ethunyelwe idlula umngcele wamazwe ngamazwe. Izinkampani ezithuthayo zidinga igama noma inkampani kokubili ekhelini lomsuka nasekhelini elizoyiswa kulo ukuze kwenziwe isimemezelo se-Customs — engeza eyodwa kwelinye nelinye ebhukwini lamakheli kuqala.
create_shipment.missing_phone_body: Le mpahla ethunyelwe idlula umngcele wamazwe ngamazwe. Izinkampani ezithuthayo zidinga inombolo yocingo kokubili ekhelini lomsuka nasekhelini elizoyiswa kulo — engeza eyodwa kwelinye nelinye ebhukwini lamakheli kuqala.
create_shipment.missing_zip_body: Faka ikhodi yeposi yalapho kuthunyelwa khona nalapho kuthunyelwe kusuka khona.
create_shipment.no_rates_body: I-EasyPost ayibuyiselanga amanani ale mpahla ethunyelwe.
create_shipment.preview_failed: Isithombe selebula asikwazanga ukulayishwa. Sebenzisa izinkinobho ezingezansi ukulivula noma ukuligcina.
create_shipment.preview_unavailable: Leli lebula liyi-PDF futhi alikwazi ukuboniswa lapha. Sebenzisa izinkinobho ezingezansi ukulivula noma ukuligcina.
create_shipment.purchased_no_label: Kuthengiwe, kodwa akukho URL yelebula ebuyisiwe.
create_shipment.save_package_dialog_labe: Nika leli phakethe igama ukuze uliqale futhi kamuva:
create_shipment.title: Dala impahla ethunyelwe & amanani okuthenga
create_shipment.zip_mode_note: Ukuhlola intengo kuphela. Ukuthenga ilebula kudinga amakheli aphelele emaceleni omabili, ngakho shintshela ku-“Amakheli aphelele” ukuze uthenge.
dashboard.placeholder_text: Izimpahla ezithunyelwe, ukulandelela, ibhuku lamakheli, nemibono yemibiko kuyongezwa ezigabeni zokwakhiwa ezizayo. Sebenzisa Izilungiselelo ukuphatha amakhiya e-API.
dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi
history.confirm_insure_purchase: Thenga ukumbozwa komshwalense we-{amount} kule mpahla ethunyelwe.
history.confirm_refund_request: Cela imali ebuyiselwe yelebula yale mpahla ethunyelwe.
history.export_none_selected: Qala ukhethe okukodwa noma okuningi okuthunyelwe okunelebula elithengiwe.
history.insurance_pending_body: Umshwalense uceliwe futhi usalindile. Ukumbozwa kuqinisekiswa uma sekufike ku-'purchased'.
history.refund_submitted_body: Imali ebuyiselwe iceliwe. Inkampani ethuthayo izoqinisekisa ngokungahambisani ngesikhathi — sebenzisa 'Hlola isimo semali ebuyiselwe' ukubheka umphumela wokugcina.
history.title: Umlando wezimpahla
hts_lookup.intro: Bheka amakhodi e-Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) awasetshenziswa ekumenyezelweni kwe-Customs, usebenzisa idatha yangesikhathi sangempela evela ku-U.S. International Trade Commission. Lokhu kuwulwazi lwesikhombo kuphela, hhayi izeluleko ze-Customs noma zomthetho — ukuhlelwa okufanele kwempahla yakho ethunyelwe kungumthwalo wakho wedwa.
hts_lookup.search_placeholder: Sesha ngegama eliphambili (isb. 'ucingo lwethusi') noma inombolo ye-HTS
hts_lookup.status_idle: Faka igama eliphambili noma inombolo ye-HTS ukuze usesha.
hts_lookup.status_live: Idatha yangesikhathi sangempela evela ku-U.S. International Trade Commission.
hts_lookup.status_offline_cache: Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi — kubonisa imiphumela egcinwe ngaphambilini, okungenzeka ingabi ngeyakamuva.
hts_lookup.status_searching: Isesha kudathabhesi ye-U.S. International Trade Commission…
hts_lookup.title: Ukubheka Ikhodi ye-HTS
insurance.intro_text: Kwizimpahla ezithengwe ngalolu hlelo lokusebenza, sebenzisa inkinobho yokuFaka umshwalense ku-Umlando esikhundleni salokhu. Sebenzisa le fomu kuphela kumalebula athengwe ngaphandle kwe-EasyPost osafuna ukuwafakela umshwalense.
insurance.missing_info_body: Ikhodi yokulandelela, inkampani ethuthayo, nenani kuyadingeka.
insurance.not_enabled_body: Le akhawunti ye-EasyPost ayivuliwe ukuthenga umshwalense ozimele. Cela usizo lwe-EasyPost ukuthi bakuvule, noma kunalokho faka umshwalense uma uthenga ilebula, okungadingi imvume ekhethekile.
insurance.pending_body: Umshwalense {id} uceliwe futhi usesimweni esithi {status}. Ukumbozwa kuqinisekiswa uma sekufike ku-'purchased'. Vuselela ukuze uhlole futhi.
insurance.title: Faka umshwalense empahleni ethunyelwe
key_check.prod_in_test_body: Ukhiye ofakwe njengokhiye wokuhlola ungukhiye wokukhiqiza osebenzayo. Ukuthumela kumodi yokukhiqiza kudinga ilayisensi. Kunalokho ufake enkambini yokukhiqiza, noma unamathisele ukhiye wokuhlola lapha ukuze uzame yonke into mahhala.
key_check.test_in_prod_body: Ukhiye ofakwe njengokhiye wokukhiqiza ungukhiye wokuhlola, ongeke ukwazi ukuthenga amalebula angempela. Faka ukhiye wokukhiqiza, noma wengeze lokhu njengokhiye wakho wokuhlola.
key_check.unverifiable_body: Asikwazanga ukuqinisekisa lowo khiye ne-EasyPost. Hlola ukhiye kanye noxhumano lwakho lwe-inthanethi, bese uzama futhi.
license_gate.buy_soon_body: Ukuthenga ku-inthanethi akukatholakali okwamanje. Sicela uphinde uhlole maduzane.
license_gate.invalid_body: Lowo khiye welayisensi awutholakalanga. Qiniseka ukuthi ukopishe wonke ukhiye ku-imeyili yakho yokuthenga, noma uxhumane nabasekelayo.
license_gate.offline_body: Ukhiye wakho uvumelekile, ngakho ungaqhubeka. Inani lamakhompyutha alikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa okwamanje; sizozama futhi ngokuzenzakalelayo. Uma kufika {date} kungakafinyeleleki, uzocelwa ukuthi uvule kabusha.
license_gate.release_body: Ilayisense yakho ihlanganisa amakhompyutha angu-{seats} futhi wonke asetshenziswa. Khetha elilodwa ukuze likhululwe, lelicomputer lithathe indawo yalo. Ikhompyutha ekhululiwe izocelwa ukuthi ivule kabusha uma iqala okulandelayo.
license_gate.release_title: Leli layisense selikuwo wonke amakhompyutha alo
license_gate.subtitle: Imodi yokuhlola imahhala. Ukuze uthumele amalebula angempela ngokhiye wokukhiqiza we-EasyPost, sebenzisa ilayisensi usebenzisa ukhiye osuka kwi-imeyili yakho yokuthenga.
license_gate.title: Vula ukuthumela kokukhiqiza
mode_banner.production_label: ⚠ Imodi yokusebenza — ukuthenga kusebenzisa imali yangempela
mode_banner.test_label: Imodi yokuhlola — azikho izindleko zangempela zenkampani ethuthayo eziyokwenzeka
pair_mobile.error_invalid_license: Umvumo awukwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Hlola umvumo ngaphansi kwezinga elithi Izilungiselelo, bese uzama futhi.
pair_mobile.error_network: Isevisi yokubhangqa ayifinyelelekanga. Hlola uxhumano, bese uzama futhi.
pair_mobile.error_no_license: Umvumo wokusebenza ngempela uyadingeka ngaphambi kokubhangqa. Yenza umvumo usebenze, bese uzama futhi.
pair_mobile.error_no_production_key: Engeza ukhiye we-EasyPost API wokusebenza ngempela ngaphansi kwezinga elithi Izilungiselelo ukuze ubhangqe i-mobile companion.
pair_mobile.error_server: Isevisi yokubhangqa ibuyise iphutha. Sicela uzame futhi maduzane.
pair_mobile.expiry_note: Le khodi isebenza imizuzu eyishumi futhi ingasetshenziswa kanye kuphela.
pair_mobile.intro: Xhuma i-Easy-Post Mobile Companion ukuze ulandelele futhi uphathe izithuthwa usebenzisa ifoni. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zeselula zizofika maduze ku-App Store nakuGoogle Play; ikhodi ekhiqizwe lapha izobhangqana ngokushesha lapho sezitholakala.
pair_mobile.needs_key: Engeza ukhiye we-EasyPost API wokusebenza ngempela ngaphansi kwezinga elithi Izilungiselelo ukuze ubhangqe i-mobile companion.
pair_mobile.needs_production: Ukubhangqa kudinga inguqulo yokusebenza ngempela. Yenza umvumo wokusebenza ngempela ube sebenza ukuze usebenzise i-mobile companion.
pair_mobile.security_note: Ukhiye we-API wokusebenza ngempela awukaze uboniswe ekhodini futhi awukaze ugcinwe ngendlela efundekayo. Ukukhiqiza ikhodi entsha kuthatha indawo yaleyo eyayikhona ngaphambilini.
pair_mobile.steps:
1. Faka i-Easy-Post Mobile Companion efonini.
2. Vula uhlelo lokusebenza bese ukhetha Bhangqa.
3. Skena ikhodi engenhla.
pair_mobile.title: Bhangqa uhlelo lokusebenza lweselula
pickups.invalid_window_body: Isikhathi sokugcina kumele sibe ngemva kwesikhathi sokuqala.
pickups.missing_info_body: Khetha ikheli nokungenani impahla eyodwa ethunyelwe.
pickups.no_rates_body: Ukulanda kudaliwe, kodwa azikho amanani enkampani ethuthayo abuyisiwe okuthenga.
pickups.one_shipment_body: I-EasyPost ilanda impahla eyodwa esicelweni ngasinye sokulanda. Hlela ukulanda okwehlukene kwenye ngayinye, noma udale i-batch kuqala.
pickups.title: Ukulanda impahla
print_sheet.title: Khiphela ngaphandle ishidi lokuphrinta
purchase_confirm.warning_body:
Ukwimodi yokusebenza. {description}

Lokhu kuzoshaja i-akhawunti yakho ye-EasyPost imali yangempela. Qhubeka?
reports.title: Umlando & ukubika
settings.forget_keys_confirm_body: Susa womabili amakhiya e-API kule khompyutha? Awathunyelwa kwenye indawo, ngakho-ke kuzodingeka uwanamathisele futhi ngaphambi kokuba ukwazi ukuthumela.
settings.label_applies_note: Kusebenza emithwalweni emisha, kufaka phakathi neyamaqoqo. Abathwali banquma usayizi welebula ngesikhathi kudalwa umthwalo, ngakho lokhu akuwashintshi amalebula asethengiwe.
settings.label_caveat_ups: I-UPS ibuyisa u-4x7 ngaphandle uma kushintshiwe. U-4x6 usebenza ku-ZPL kuphela, ngaphandle uma i-EasyPost Support ivula u-4x6 PNG ku-akhawunti yakho (imithwalo yasekhaya kuphela). U-4x7 no-4x8 empeleni yilebula u-4x6 elinezikhala ezingenalutho.
settings.label_caveat_zpl_only: I-LaserShip ne-OnTrac zisekela u-4x6 no-4x8 ku-ZPL kuphela.
settings.language_restart_note: Qala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ushintsho lolimi lusebenze ngokugcwele.
settings.sheet_needs_png_note: Amashidi amalebula akhiwe ngezithombe zamalebula, ngakho ifomethi ishintshwe isuka ku-{format} yaya ku-PNG. Amalebula e-{format} awakwazi ukubekwa eshidini.
settings.title: Izilungiselelo
settings.webhook_status_stopped: Ayisebenzi. Ukulandelela kusalungiswa nge-polling njalo ngemizuzu emi-5.
setup_wizard.key_required_body: Faka okungenani ikhiya le-API elilodwa (lokuhlola noma lokusebenza) ukuze uqhubeke.
setup_wizard.subtitle: Namathisela ikhiya/amakhiya akho e-EasyPost API ngezansi. Agcinwa ngokuphepha kusiphathimanejala samukelo lwesistimu yokusebenza kule mshini — awakaze abhalwe ngombhalo ovulekile, awakaze athunyelwe kwenye indawo ngaphandle kwe-API ye-EasyPost.
setup_wizard.title: Xhuma i-akhawunti yakho ye-EasyPost
store_unlock.buy_in_store_body: I-Microsoft Store ivule ikhasi le-Easy-Post Desktop. Thenga ukuvula kwemodi yokukhiqiza lapho, bese ubuyela lapha bese ukhetha okuthi Buyisela.
store_unlock.enter_code_invalid_body: Hlola ikhodi bese uzama futhi. Uma inkinga iqhubeka, xhumana nabasekelayo.
store_unlock.enter_code_prompt: Namathisela ikhodi yakho yokuvula ukuze uvule imodi yokukhiqiza.
store_unlock.error_body: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle ekufinyeleleni i-Microsoft Store. Sicela uhlole ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
store_unlock.multi_seat_link: Unikeza ilayisensi amakhompiyutha angaphezu kwelilodwa, noma iqembu? Thola ilayisensi yezihlalo eziningi
store_unlock.restore_none_body: Akukho ukuvula kwemodi yokukhiqiza okutholakele kule akhawunti ye-Microsoft. Uma usanda kukuthenga, linda umzuzwana bese uzama futhi, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi ungene ku-Store ngale akhawunti othenge ngayo.
store_unlock.subtitle: Imodi yokuhlola imahhala. Ukuze uthumele amalebula angempela ngokhiye we-EasyPost wokukhiqiza, vula imodi yokukhiqiza kule khompiyutha ngokuthenga kwakanye.
store_unlock.title: Vula ukuthunyelwa kwemodi yokukhiqiza
tracking.title: Ukulandelela
